description.en: Hanafi jurist, specialist in Islamic inheritance law

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: Abd al-Wahhāb b. Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. ʿAbdallāh b. Ibrāhīm, Tāj al-Dīn, Abū Nasr, Hibat Allāh al-Ṭarkhānī, then al-Dimashqī, resident of Cairo, known like his father as Ibn ʿArabshāh

tr: Abdülvehhâb b. Ahmed b. Muhammed b. Abdullah b. İbrâhîm, Tâcüddîn, Ebû Nasr, Hibetullah et-Tarhânî, sonra ed-Dımaşkî, Kahire sakinlerinden, babası gibi İbn Arabşâh ile meşhur
ar: عبد الوهاب بن أحمد بن محمد بن عبد الله بن إبراهيم، تاج الدين، أبو نصر،هبة الله الطرخاني ثم الدمشقي، نزيل القاهرة، المعروف - كأبيه - بابن عربشاه

derived_from.edition_or_version: Khayr al-Dīn al-Ziriklī, al-Aʿlām (Beirut: Dār al-ʿIlm li’l-Malāyīn, 8th ed. 2002), 8 vols.
